name: After recital 6
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Decision (EU) 2015/1814 as regards the market stability reserve for the buildings, road transport and additional sectors
part_text: Amendment (6a) The review of the market stability reserve for buildings, road transport and other sectors should take full account of the real economic and social impact of the emissions trading system. Where significant adverse impacts on households, mobility, competitiveness or small- and medium-sized enterprises are identified, the review should also cover the suspension or repeal of the emissions trading system regulated under Chapter IVa of Directive 2003/87/EC as a legislative option.
